span.p:
CheckoutView (/checkout)
• Selects Bank Transfer Rail
• Initiates Order & Payment Session

div.style: color: rgb(224, 231, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
BankSimulationView (/checkout/bank-sim)
• Displays Amount & Dual Currency (USD/NPR)
• Pre-fills Mock Bank Reference (TXN-BNK-...)
• Optional Custom Reference / Slip Notes
• Submits Simulated Transfer

div.style: color: rgb(220, 252, 231) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ConfirmationView (/checkout/confirmation)
• Order Confirmed Banner
• Payment Status: PENDING VERIFICATION
• Displays Captured Bank Voucher Reference

div.style: color: rgb(224, 231, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Test Settlement Helper
• simulateBankSettlementAction()
• Simulates PENDING -> PAID or FAILED

div.style: color: rgb(244, 244, 245) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
initiateOrderPaymentAction()
• Retrieves Pending Order
• Invokes PaymentOrchestrator
• Returns Bank Simulation Redirect URL

div.style: color: rgb(244, 244, 245) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
confirmBankTransferAction()
• Captures Voucher Code & Memo
• Transitions Payment Status to PENDING
• Records Financial Audit Trail

div.style: color: rgb(244, 244, 245) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
simulateBankSettlementAction()
• QA/Admin Verification Tool
• Settles (PAID) or Rejects (FAILED)

div.style: color: rgb(224, 231, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PaymentOrchestrator (JN-244)
• Selects Adapter by Rail / Currency (JN-245)
• USD: International Bank Wire Rail
• NPR: Nepal Domestic Bank Transfer Rail
• Enforces Idempotency (JN-249)

div.style: color: rgb(224, 231, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
IPaymentProvider (Interface - JN-240)
• initiatePayment(order, opts)
• confirmTransfer(paymentId, ref)
• verifyWebhook(payload, sig)
• processRefund(paymentId, amount)

div.style: color: rgb(224, 231, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
IPaymentRepository (Port)
• findById(id)
• findByOrderId(orderId)
• findByIdempotencyKey(key)
• save(payment, tx)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
SimulatedBankAdapter (Passable Bank Rail)
• Implements IPaymentProvider
• Generates /checkout/bank-sim URL
• Captures Mock Bank Slip Reference
• Resolves Passable Status: PENDING
• Future Hook: Real Bank SDK Integration

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(253, 242, 248) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Payment Aggregate Root (JN-075, JN-241)
• Status: INITIATED -> PENDING -> PAID
• Idempotency Key Enforced
• Dual Currency: Display vs Settlement (JN-252/253)
• Financial Audit Ledger (JN-254)

div.style: color: rgb(253, 242, 248) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Payment Domain Events
• PaymentPendingEvent
• PaymentSettledEvent (JN-107)
• PaymentFailedEvent (JN-120)
• PaymentRefundedEvent (JN-114)

div.style: color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
DrizzlePaymentRepository (JN-051)
• ACID Transaction Support
• Dual Currency & Reference Persistence
• Outbox Event Publishing
